title: Dashboard: Vocabulary Bank by Language
description: Display practiced words grouped by language and mastery level. MOBILE-FIRST responsive with Tailwind.

technicalContext.schema: userWordProgress: { userId, word, language, practiceCount, lastPracticed }
technicalContext.responsive: MOBILE-FIRST: Collapsible accordion on mobile, expanded grid on desktop
technicalContext.tailwind: Use Tailwind: collapse/expand animations, responsive flex/grid

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create Convex schema for userWordProgress table
Create mutation to record word practice when user clicks a word
Create query to get all words for current user grouped by language
Group words by language with collapsible sections
Within each language, show mastery breakdown: New / Learning / Mastered
Display word count per level (e.g., 'Learning: 45 words')
Expandable to see actual words in each level
Click word shows tooltip with practice count and last practiced
MOBILE-FIRST: Accordion-style collapsible sections on mobile (320px+)
TAILWIND RESPONSIVE: Word chips wrap naturally with flex-wrap
UX: Smooth expand/collapse animations, clear tap targets
UI: Color-coded mastery levels (green=mastered, yellow=learning, gray=new)
